title: Was in the middle of a festival and spilled a tea pot, and everyone got really mad.
content: My dreams have been wild lately. I wanted to share part of my dream from last night and some common experiences that I see on here. I went lucid last night, bought a dessert and a macchiato at a fair stand (barely tasted like anything), turned and suddenly it was day time, and I accidentally knocked over a stack of trays and spilled a tea pot. A lady in a fancy dress started screaming at me, everyone started chasing us, I suddenly had an umbrella, I opened it and grabbed my friend's arm (who changed from a black man to a middle aged white woman during the sequence) and was able to use my mind to catch some wind and float us on a rooftop, suddenly we're in a neighborhood on top of a worn down house, and two teenage girls are chasing us and threatening to kill us. I'm climbing around the roof, accidentally slip down, it's clear we are about to be caught, and I wake myself up by doing that thing where you close your eyes really tightly and then open them quickly. My lucid dreams always end with me being chased and having to wake myself up out of fear. In my dream state I pulled out my phone and used my mind to turn on a song on Spotify, but the screen was jumbled and it felt like if I touched it I would wake up. Another thing I experience when I go lucid is if I try to focus too hard on any one thing, I wake up. This includes thinking too hard trying to change too much in the environment. I tried to ask someone if they knew they were a part of a dream, but I'm not quite sure how they answered. It didn't make much sense, and the environment quickly changed. I am never conscious of how the environment is changing until I wake up and reflect on it. Day changes to night, outside to inside, festivals to neighborhoods, houses to concert halls. It's weird that it goes unnoticed for the most part, unless I go lucid. I started going lucid about two months ago, but it seems to be happening a bit more frequently. It generally happens when I am able to notice a change in the environment or if I recognize something is different than it is in real life. Last couple of times I can't think of any specific trigger; it's like I suddenly just knew "oh I'm dreaming".
